text: Restore formation cohort priority spread progress without weakening safety. The causal blocker in formation cohort spread curing was twofold: (1) unified-rebalancer-available-nodes.js checked formationReleaseHandoff?.releaseAuthorized === true in isFormationCohortSpreadCureTarget, but during formation handoff RETAINED_UNTIL_READY release is never authorized until cohort readiness is achieved, creating a circular wait where joining nodes stalled on NODE_READY_LEASE_INCOMPLETE without ever receiving priority spread replicas; and (2) in move-planner-move-calculation-methods.js, applyPrioritySpreadExpandCure converts candidate replace moves into expand-cure ADDs by clearing candidate removes and returning 0, which caused replaceSerializationCap: true to be falsely attributed when comparing replaceCount < naturalReplaceCount afterwards. We resolve this by checking formationReleaseHandoffActive without requiring premature releaseAuthorized === true, and tracking replaceSerializationCapActive based on replaceCountBeforeSpreadCure.

Fixed circular wait in isFormationCohortSpreadCureTarget by decoupling formation cohort spread curing from premature releaseAuthorized check during active handoff; fixed false replaceSerializationCap attribution in calculateMoves by evaluating cap condition before applyPrioritySpreadExpandCure converts replaces to expand-cure ADDs; authored comprehensive witness covering causal divergence, 4 historical failure families, composed safety & finite failure progress, negative control, and owned canonical wake bounds.
